name: Co-op
author: UnderRailWorks
description: Play together. Host from the Co-op button on the HUD (choose how much XP is shared); others use Join a Game on the main menu, make a character in the game's own creation (or pick one saved with the host's game), and play it in the host's world: walking, fighting (the whole zone together, as the game does), doors and objects, looting, trading, conversations (everyone listens), travelling as a group. Other mods can add host options and their own messages (Co-op's API).
